text: Why was the Ambassador particularly lucky?
When the Ambassador of Escalopia returned home for lunch, his wife got a shock.
zh: 当埃斯卡洛比亚大使回家吃午饭时，他的妻子吓了一跳。
zh_hant: 當埃斯卡洛比亞大使回家吃午飯時，他的妻子嚇了一跳。

text: He looked pale and his clothes were in a frightful state.
zh: 他脸色苍白，衣服也糟透了。
zh_hant: 他臉色蒼白，衣服也糟透了。

text: 'What has happened?'
she asked.
'How did your clothes get into such a mess?'
zh: 你的衣服怎么弄得这么狼狈？
zh_hant: 你的衣服怎麼弄得這麼狼狽？

text: 'A fire extinguisher, my dear,' answered the Ambassador drily.
zh: '灭火器，亲爱的，'大使干巴巴地回答。
zh_hant: '滅火器，親愛的，'大使乾巴巴地回答。

text: 'University students set the Embassy on fire this morning.'
zh: 今天早上大学生们放火烧了大使馆。
zh_hant: 今天早上大學生們放火燒了大使館。

text: 'Good heavens!'
exclaimed his wife.
'And where were you at the time?'
'I was in my office as usual,' answered the Ambassador.
zh: '我像往常一样在办公室里，'大使回答。
zh_hant: '我像往常一樣在辦公室裡，'大使回答。

text: 'The fire broke out in the basement.
zh: 火灾是从地下室开始的。
zh_hant: 火災是從地下室開始的。

text: I went down immediately, of course,
and that fool, Horst, aimed a fire extinguisher at me.
zh: 那个傻瓜霍斯特却拿灭火器对着我喷。
zh_hant: 那個傻瓜霍斯特卻拿滅火器對著我噴。

text: He thought I was on fire.
I must definitely get that fellow posted.'
zh: 我非得把那个家伙调走不可。
zh_hant: 我非得把那個傢伙調走不可。

text: The Ambassador's wife went on asking questions,
zh: 大使的妻子继续问问题，
zh_hant: 大使的妻子繼續問問題，

text: when she suddenly noticed a big hole in her husband's hat.
zh: 这时她突然注意到丈夫帽子上有个大洞。
zh_hant: 這時她突然注意到丈夫帽子上有個大洞。

text: 'And how can you explain
that?'
she asked.
'Oh, that,' said the Ambassador.
'Someone fired a shot through my office window.
zh: 有人朝我的办公室窗户开了一枪。
zh_hant: 有人朝我的辦公室窗戶開了一槍。

text: Accurate, don't you think?
Fortunately, I wasn't wearing it at the time.
If I had been, I would not have been able to get home for lunch.'
zh: 要是戴着的话，我就回不了家吃午饭了。
zh_hant: 要是戴著的話，我就回不了家吃午飯了。
